{"id":2047204123,"question_id":4074,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 weeks, 5 days","timestamp":1782503262,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"15 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2047204123/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Subarrays With Majority Element I","memory":"42.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int countMajoritySubarrays(vector<int>& nums, int target) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        unordered_map<int,int>mp;\n        mp[0] = 1;\n\n        int cumsum = 0;\n        int count = 0;\n        int leftsmallerones = 0;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            if(nums[i] == target)\n            {\n                leftsmallerones += mp[cumsum];\n                cumsum++;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                cumsum--;\n                leftsmallerones -= mp[cumsum];\n            }\n            mp[cumsum]++;\n            count += leftsmallerones;\n        }\n        return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-subarrays-with-majority-element-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2233}
